method: Read complete main answer and all model responses, actual tool messages and mechanical observations, fourth request checker input, signed-wire records, independent provider/consumer order files, and decrypted persisted consumer AgentStore through read-only _read. Recomputed all98 code snapshot hashes. No new API or probe, no held-out access, no production/raw-run edits; only this new review artifact.

findings.claim: node-c 调不到 model-b 的直接原因是授权链上没有 model-b 的条目
findings.supporting_inference_quote: 因此也没有可附加接收授权的分享条目
findings.evidence: ryn_list_models/ryn_inspect_services expose only model-a to the executing node-b; remote row sharing_configuration_known=false/share_scope=unknown and friend_grants_scope.remote_provider_grants=unknown. ryn_list_source_configurations sources=[] describes local node-b only.
findings.assessment: A missing model-b row in this recipient catalogue cannot establish absence of a provider sharing/grant entry, or the direct cause of node-c inability. Opening qualification about locally verifiable data does not support the subsequent affirmative remote causal claim. Final paragraph correctly says remote state and node-c view are unavailable and absence is not proof of remote non-sharing; this contradicts rather than repairs the opening.

findings.claim: 没有出现在任何好友关系或授权记录里
findings.evidence: ryn_list_devices.self_id is executing node-b and friends contains only owner-provider. ryn_inspect_services.friend_grants_scope explicitly names node-b provider_peer_id and local_outgoing direction.
findings.assessment: Node-c absence from node-b friendships/outgoing grants is a valid local observation, but it is used under evidence for provider-model-b-to-node-c authorization. It does not prove the provider has no node-c relationship/grant. The hypothetical statement about sharing via this node does not establish the actual remote cause.

supported_or_improved_components: Correctly separates exact model-a service/model generation/consumer binding from model-b and node-c; no inherited same-source authority.
Correctly limits expired heartbeat evidence: current reachability is unverified and offline cannot be concluded from the unperformed HTTP/LAN observations.
Correctly treats model-a current_access unknown/invocation_verified false as catalogue observation rather than live invocation verification; no universal never-tested claim here.
Correctly reports no task configuration changes and that remote model-b configuration remains invisible, though the latter conflicts with the affirmative causal conclusion.

checker.interpretation: Provider and consumer durable order histories both reach timed_out with inference_timeout, supporting protocol-level timeout independently of elapsed duration. Runtime maps it to generic agent_inference_failed. No evidence here proves which network/upstream phase caused the timeout or that remote model computation actually stopped.
checker.semantic_effect: No checker verdict was obtained; unverified is failure to establish the goal, not evidence that semantic grounding was fixed. No checker false-pass claim for this run.

mechanisms.setup_scope: Setup admission probes are separate collector ground truth, not information supplied to the model or fresh node-c task tests. They cannot retroactively justify the answer.
